hook: Telangana inflation hits *7.26%*, first time above 7% this year
hook_b: Telangana inflation hits *7.26%*, first time above 7% this year
tldr: NSO data show Telangana's CPI inflation rose to 7.26% in October from 6.64% in September, against 6.09% nationally.

beats.what: Telangana is among six states above 7%, with Tamil Nadu (7.29%) slightly higher.
beats.why: Food prices led nationally; a CESS economist says lower farm output due to El Niño could be one reason, and rice prices added in Telangana.
beats.care: Everyday costs (food, rent, hostel mess) rise faster than the national average here.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Nationally, onion prices rose 116% year on year in October and garlic 61%, per NSO.

cards.q: Where are rising prices hurting you most?

qs: Why is rural inflation higher than urban here?
Will food prices ease after the next harvest?

facts.t: India's food inflation rose to *8.94%* in October from 7.74% in September.

viz.verdict: Rising prices cut what households can buy

insight: Rural Telangana is hit harder: 8.05% against 6.68% in towns and cities.

learn.t: CPI inflation = how fast prices of things households buy rise, year on year

watch: November CPI data from NSO, due next month.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: T's inflation breaches 7% mark in Oct, zooms past national avg

fact: Telangana retail inflation crossed *7%* in October, for the first time in 2026
twist: It has stayed above the national average for *10 months* straight; October's gap was 1.17 points.
